user_query: I'm planning a trip to Asia and I need to know the time zones of different countries. Can you provide a list of countries in Asia along with their capital cities and time zones? It would be helpful to have the subregions within each country as well.

TaskList.description: Retrieve a list of countries in Asia along with their capital cities.
For each country retrieved, gather information about the time zones associated with each capital city.
Collect subregion information for each country in Asia.
Compile and format the collected data into a cohesive summary.
